cues.text: A white moogle rides a yellow chocobo, charging across the field.
A cartoon explosion! The moogle reels, spiral-eyed, with stars circling its head.
A huge, round yellow chocobo drops onto the enemy in a puff of dust, then bounces away.
White lights drift down. Shiva appears, blue-skinned, with long green hair and a violet wrap.
She sweeps one arm overhead, gathering a ball of blue light.
Glittering frost surrounds the enemy. Jagged blue ice bursts from the ground and shatters.
A pillar of fire lifts a horned, muscular beast out of the ground.
Ifrit bares his fangs, his long mane whipping behind him.
He plunges toward the enemy. Flames engulf the ground in a blazing orange explosion.
Forks of lightning strike the ground. A rocky pinnacle rises amid flying stones.
At its summit stands Ramuh, a white-robed old man with a long beard and staff.
He raises the staff. Branching blue lightning lashes outward, engulfing the enemy in light.
The earth bulges. Titan, a bare-chested, muscular giant, heaves himself out.
He crouches and grips the ground beneath the enemy, straining to lift an enormous slab.
He flips the whole slab over. Rock crashes down and breaks apart.
Clouds part around a full moon. A mounted warrior appears in silhouette on a rocky crag.
Odin's many-legged horse rears, his black cape streaming.
His horned armor gleams as they charge. A blue sword slashes across the enemies.
A blue line cuts across the enemies as horse and rider gallop away.
The sky darkens, and rain streaks across the battlefield.
Odin rides in on his gray, many-legged horse, carrying a glowing pink lance.
His horned helmet tilts upward. He draws back his arm and hurls the lance into the clouds.
A blue ring opens overhead. The lance plunges through it, spearing the ground in a flash.
A sphere of water spins above the enemy, then breaks open into a long sea serpent.
Leviathan coils through the air, teal-scaled, with pale fins and long whiskers.
Water rises around the battlefield. A towering wave curls over and crashes across the enemy.
A purple vortex churns in the dark sky, its bright center swelling open.
Bahamut emerges: a gray, armored dragon with a golden chest, swept-back horns, and broad violet wings.
He throws his head back, gathering light in his jaws.
A thick blue-white beam pours down, engulfing the enemy in a blinding column.
Purple lightning lashes the enemy. Shards of ice whirl together into a frozen sphere.
Golden sparks scatter. Flames surge upward, exploding across the ground.
A massive brown bull appears, with curling horns and a jagged red mane down its back.
Kujata stamps down. The ground jolts beneath the enemy.
Cracks tear across the ground. Steam billows from a widening black chasm.
Alexander rises: an immense mechanical fortress with towers, gold trim, and two thick, column-like arms.
Blue light gathers beneath its face. It aims its enormous arms toward the enemy.
Beams converge from both sides. A brilliant white explosion fills the battlefield.
A golden spark descends. It blooms into a pillar of flame.
Phoenix rises from the blaze, a huge red-and-gold bird with a long, flowing tail.
Its wings spread wide. Radiant streaks fan outward, washing across the battlefield.
Cracks encircle the enemies. The ground beneath them breaks free in one enormous slab.
The slab rises between towering banks of cloud, carrying them high above the world.
Neo Bahamut hovers before the floating rock: a red dragon with long horns and four spreading wings.
He draws his head back. White light gathers between his open jaws.
A broad golden beam tears across the slab, blasting it into fragments.
Shattered rock tumbles through a white flash, and the battlefield returns.
Small flames encircle the enemies. A patterned stone platform rises through a ring of smoke.
Pillars stand around a huge cauldron. A shadowy figure looms behind it.
Hades reveals a grinning skull beneath a dark red hood. He bends over the bubbling cauldron.
He spreads his arms. Thick magenta vapor spills outward, curling around the enemy in rolling clouds.
A green whirlwind coils up from the ground, widening into a spinning funnel.
Typhon drops from it: a plump pink creature with clawed arms and a huge, toothy mouth.
It blows flame toward the enemy. Wind and flying stones twist upward around them.
Typhon turns, revealing another snarling face on its back. The whole battlefield rolls upside down.
The upturned ground crashes down in a storm of rocks and purple light.
The view rushes into space. The blue-white planet hangs against a field of stars.
A vast shadow passes overhead, dwarfing the curve of the planet.
Bahamut ZERO glides into view: a metallic gray dragon with a spiked head and six immense wings.
Its three pairs of wings spread. Purple light pulses around its body.
A bright blue sphere builds between its jaws, sending sharp rays in every direction.
The dragon fires a narrow beam down toward the planet.
The beam pierces the clouds and bears down on the battlefield.
A golden blast swells into a blazing dome, swallowing the enemy before the light fades.

name: Knights of the Round: Ultimate End

cues.text: Violet light encloses the enemy. A circular portal pulls the battlefield into darkness.
Against a red void, an armored knight sweeps a huge, jagged sword through the enemy.
A lance-bearing knight charges. A red-robed mage follows, hurling a rolling fireball.
Against a blue void, a golden knight strikes with his mace and shield.
A pink-armored swordsman lunges. A green knight follows with a massive hammer.
A robed knight thrusts his staff, sending out a branching wave of frost.
Another raises a three-pronged staff. Golden rays flash across a swirling starfield.
A towering knight drives down a meteor, which bursts into chunks of rock.
A swordsman sweeps his long blade across the enemy, leaving a brilliant trail.
Another knight swings a great axe. White light flares along its broad edge.
A final swordsman charges through the stars. The swirling realm falls black.
A giant king descends, a long red cape flowing behind him. He lifts an enormous silver sword.
His two-handed blow floods the scene with white light.
The glowing world cracks and shatters like glass, revealing the battlefield again.
Cloud leaps with his sword overhead, then chops straight down.
Cloud lunges in, carving three bright slashes into a glowing symbol across the enemy.
Cloud swings his sword down, launching a glowing shockwave along the ground.
Cloud drives his sword into the enemy, then leaps upward, dragging the blade with him.
Cloud spins his sword and leaps.
Blazing meteors rain down, striking the enemies in rapid flashes.
Cloud spins, then whips his sword overhead.
The tornado surges across the enemies, lifting rocks and debris into its glowing column.
Cloud raises his sword into a column of golden light.
He rushes in, slashing again and again. Each sweeping blow bursts into white and green light.
Cloud leaps high, drawing the blazing sword above his head.
He plunges down with a two-handed strike. A blinding explosion swallows the battlefield.
Barret levels his gun arm and fires a swelling ball of yellow light.
Barret fires a blue-white sphere from his gun arm, bursting against the enemy.
Barret launches a glowing grenade high into the air.
It drops onto the enemy and bursts in a spreading explosion.
Barret charges in and swings a rising punch, knocking the enemy skyward.
The view rises overhead. Red targeting sights sweep across the battlefield and lock onto the enemies.
White-blue beams lance down from above. Explosions expand in rings of light.
Barret braces his gun arm and unleashes a barrage, muzzle flashes strobing with each shot.
Barret spreads his arms and rises into the air. Light gathers at his gun arm.
He aims down, pouring out a thick golden beam. Explosions flare as he sweeps it across the enemy.
Tifa pounds the enemy with quick punches.
Tifa backflips with a rising kick.
Tifa sweeps a watery kick.
Tifa hoists the enemy into a backward slam.
Tifa uppercuts alongside a leaping dolphin.
Tifa leaps high, then hurls the enemy down.
Golden light gathers around Tifa's fist.
Her punch releases a brilliant shock wave.
Aerith raises her arms as blue sparkles drift in circles around the party.
Aerith raises her staff, sending a white flash across the enemies.
Aerith lifts her staff as circling winds and golden stars surround the party.
Aerith holds her staff aloft. Blue lightning branches around her companions, followed by spheres of golden light.
Stars circle the party, and each figure becomes wrapped in a translucent golden glow.
Aerith clasps her hands and kneels. Blue-white stars stream through slender columns of light around the party.
Aerith closes her eyes in prayer. Golden pools of light spread beneath her companions.
Small winged angels descend through an opening in the swirling clouds.
Red Thirteen hurtles forward, leaving a blue streak behind him.
Red Thirteen howls, and golden flames rise around his companions.
Red Thirteen pounces and swipes as glowing orbs stream back toward him.
Red Thirteen howls toward the sky, and a shower of bright stars rains onto the enemy.
Red Thirteen rises onto his hind legs and howls against a huge full moon.
Red Thirteen darts and leaps through the enemy, striking with his claws amid fiery bursts.
Red Thirteen raises his head. A field of stars spins around a red sphere above him.
Points of light spiral inward. The sphere swells, glowing like a miniature sun.
It fires a huge beam across the battlefield. Flame and jagged slabs of rock engulf the enemies.
Cid springs into the air, then plunges spear-first onto the enemy.
Cid lights a stick of dynamite with his cigarette, then tosses it toward the enemy.
It explodes in a red-orange flash as he ducks away.
Cid twirls his spear and leaps. His landing sends a ring of energy across the ground.
Cid points his spear. A translucent blue dragon twists around the enemy in falling green light.
A glowing orb streams back toward Cid.
Cid crouches and rockets upward, spear poised.
He plunges down again and again, rebounding between blows as white bursts flash below.
A final dive drives a tall column of colored light into the ground.
Cid rushes in, jabbing and swinging his spear through a rapid flurry of blows.
Cid raises his spear overhead, then waves to the sky.
Missiles streak down in curving trails, peppering the enemy with bright explosions and billowing smoke.
The barrage ends in a tall flare surrounded by fanning trails of smoke.
Yuffie dashes past the enemy, slashes with her shuriken, and flips back into place.
Yuffie spreads her arms. Blue-violet bubbles rise around each companion, shimmering before they fade.
Yuffie thrusts her hand toward the ground. A blue ring spreads beneath the enemies.
Rocky slabs burst upward, tossing dust and debris into the air.
Yuffie darts back and forth, striking repeatedly through bright red streaks.
Yuffie thrusts her hand forward, and a towering blue beam erupts inside a glowing circle.
Yuffie streaks between the enemies, swinging her shuriken through bursts of violet light.
She vaults upward for the final strikes, then flips back toward her companions.
Yuffie holds her weapon close and rises off the ground. Red light fills the air around her.
She releases a tremendous multicolored beam. It widens across the enemies, bleaching the scene white.
Vincent becomes a horned purple beast with a red mane, clawed hands, and a long tail.
The horned beast lunges at the enemy, slashing with its claws.
The horned beast gathers light and launches blazing golden orbs that burst around the enemy.
Vincent becomes a hulking gray-green monster, with mismatched limbs and large bolts protruding from its shoulders.
The hulking monster charges forward and drives a heavy fist into the enemy.
Electric orbs gather around the hulking monster, then burst into crackling arcs across the battlefield.
Vincent becomes a hunched, white-masked figure in ragged clothes, a long chainsaw clutched in one hand.
The masked figure lunges in and tears through a rapid series of chainsaw swings.
The masked figure sends eerie green lights and drifting mist swirling around the enemy.
Vincent becomes a horned demon. Broad red bat wings unfurl from his back as he hovers.
The winged demon sweeps forward, sending a sharp wave of energy across the enemy.
A huge stone skull pushes up beneath the enemies, its teeth forming a jagged grin.
Orange fire blazes from its eye sockets. The skull fractures, scattering chunks of rock across the ground.
Cait Sith tosses giant white dice, which bounce and tumble across the battlefield.
Tiny red-uniformed soldiers march into a line. They shoulder their rifles and fire together.
Cait Sith's big moogle bounces and sways, waving both arms as colorful stars swirl around the party.
A floating woman blows a kiss, and pink hearts swell around the party.
The other party members vanish as Cait Sith and his moogle grow to an enormous size.
A small red-cloaked figure appears in white smoke, sweeps its curved blade, then vanishes.
Red skulls rise around the party, their jaws gaping as a crimson glow pulses.
A broad slab crashes down and shatters into pale fragments around the enemy.
Blue icicles burst around the enemy amid glittering snowflakes.
A huge black weight marked with a white question mark drops onto the enemy.
An oversized mallet swings down onto the enemy.

name: Cait Sith: Toy Box Fat Chocobo

cues.text: A fat yellow chocobo plummets onto the enemy, landing in a puff of dust.
A red-roofed house drops from above and crashes down in a cloud of dust.
Small blazing meteors tumble down, bursting around the enemy in golden explosions.
Colored orbs circle the summoner in rising green light.
